title: Issuer
description: A party able to sign claims about vehicles it has directly handled. Every Issuer has a verifiable identity (a DID) tied to a real, identifiable legal entity by a documented onboarding check. An Issuer's past signatures stay verifiable after its status changes — suspension affects new issuance, not the checkability of history.

trust_class.description: T2 for a verified professional; T3 for an authorised institution. A property of the ONBOARDING EVIDENCE, recorded and re-assessable — not of the issuer_type alone.

legal_entity.description: Business identity only. This is a company, not a person: no natural-person data belongs here.

authority_scope.description: What this issuer is authorised to attest. A claim outside scope raises an issuer_out_of_scope anomaly rather than being silently accepted.
